settings.enableDiscussionList-Help: Numbered pages on the index page instead of the "Load More" button.
settings.perPage-Help: How many discussions to show per page. Without pagination it sizes each "Load More" batch.
settings.enablePostStream-Help: Numbered pages inside a discussion instead of infinite scrolling.
settings.postsPerPage-Help: How many posts to show per discussion page. Works only when post pagination is enabled.
settings.enablePostList-Help: Numbered pages instead of the "Load More" button on the user profile feed and the posts page.
settings.postListPerPage-Help: How many posts to show per feed page. Without pagination it sizes each "Load More" batch.
settings.urlPage-Help: Links like ?page=2 open the right page, and the browser back/forward buttons navigate the list and the feed.
settings.pagerMode-Help: Full shows the edge pages, the numbers around the current one and a jump field; compact shows just the numbers around the current one; line shows a counter with an input like the admin pager; mini shows arrows and the position only.
settings.pagerWindow-Help: How many page numbers to show on each side of the current page.
settings.pagerButtonSize-Help: Pager button height and width. Defaults to 36.
settings.pagerCounter-Help: Display the current page and the total under the pager. Full and compact modes only.
settings.pagerJumpList-Help: Show the page-number input in the discussion list pager.
settings.pagerJumpStream-Help: Show the page-number input in the post stream pager.
settings.pagerJumpFeed-Help: Show the page-number input on the profile activity feed and the posts page.
settings.pagerScrollOffset-Help: How many pixels above the first discussion or post to land when switching pages. A negative value lands below it.
settings.pagerPreview-Help: Click an icon in the preview to change it. An empty field or "Reset" restores the default icon.
settings.mobileCompact-Help: On phones the pager turns into the mini one — arrows and the current position only.
settings.mobileButtonSize-Help: Pager button height and width on phones. Defaults to 22.
settings.mobileHideJump-Help: Do not show the page-number input on phones.
settings.mobileHideCounter-Help: Do not show "Page X of Y" on phones.
